addressed.claim_id: Fixed inverted remainder-cent distribution order: sort by descending fractional remainder with ties broken by larger weight then lower index via key (-remainders[i], -weights[i], i)
Replaced context-dependent Decimal arithmetic (quantize validation, abs(amount)*100, Decimal sum/division, Decimal division for cents->Decimal) with exact integer/rational arithmetic
Derived total cents exactly from Decimal tuple (digits*10^(exp+2) with exp>=-2 check) avoiding InvalidOperation/precision loss for >28-digit totals
Scaled Decimal weights to integers via common exponent and computed floors/remainders as (cents*Wi)//W and %W, with tie-break on integer numerator and integer weight
Constructed results directly as Decimal((sign,digits,-2)) with exponent -2, preserving negative-total negation and zero handling
